findings.detail: The flagged cost_currency values are non-USD even though the raw SOI presents the Cost and Fair Value columns as dollar-denominated; the foreign unit belongs to the par/principal field, not cost.

rationale: FX03 is a real data error. The SOI headers define separate Par/Shares/Units, Cost, and Fair Value columns, and dollar markers appear on the Cost/Fair Value columns and totals. In the foreign-denominated example, the EUR marker is attached to the par/principal amount while the cost amount is under the dollar-denominated Cost column. The extracted non-USD cost_currency therefore reflects currency leakage from the par/principal field into cost_currency, not a valid non-USD cost column.
